_note: The game layer (hub/game.js, 2026-11-26; spec: 'Numidea game loop spec'). Encre is never stored: hub/game.js adds it up from the keys the pages already keep. pts are the Encre per thing finished; ranks are the ten ranks (at = Encre needed), each with the drawing it unlocks (a hub/bible/art file, its true size, and its alt key lant.ui.game.u.N) and, from rank 2, obj: the lantern part found there (its drawn icon in hub/game.js, its name lant.ui.game.o.N, its line lant.ui.game.od.N; the Zelda-feel plan, 2026-11-28). discount: the rank that shows the first-project code (a placeholder the owner confirms by hand on WhatsApp, once per client; nothing redeems it). service: where a finished book's commission card points (a path from the site root). The build (scripts/lib/lanterne.mjs) adds each book's acts and keys and writes all of it into the pages as #game-data.
